  • Dynamic per-key RGB illumination – Gorgeous color schemes and reactive effects for every key

aplus content video

APEX 5

Best of Both Worlds

The Apex 5 combines the smoothness of a membrane switch with the added durability, performance, and satisfying tactile click of a blue mechanical switch, for a premium gaming experience where you don’t have to choose one over the other.

Previous page

  1. OLED Smart Display

    Customize the OLED screen with your favorite gifs, view game info, Discord messages, and more.

  2. Aircraft-grade aluminum alloy

    The Series 5000 metal frame is manufactured for a lifetime of unbreakable durability and sturdiness.

  3. Premium magnetic wrist rest

    The Series 5000 metal frame is manufactured for a lifetime of unbreakable durability and sturdiness.

Next page
Previous page

  1. Dedicated multimedia controls

    A clickable metal roller and media keys allow you to adjust volume and settings on the fly: rewind, skip, pause, and more, all at the touch of a button.

  2. Three-way cable routing

    Prevent your cable from getting in the way. The frame has built-in channels that allow you to choose from one of three possible places for your cable to exit, keeping your desk tidy.

  3. Dynamic per-key RGB illumination

    Millions of color options and reactive typing effects make you the designer of your ultimate setup. Sync up with your other SteelSeries gear for the most gorgeous setup ever.

Next page

Complete your SteelSeries setup

Previous page

  2. SteelSeries Mice

    Our gaming mice feature advanced optical sensors, RGB illumination, and are compatible with PC and Mac.

    Learn more

  3. SteelSeries Headsets

    The most premium headsets in gaming. Every Arctis headset comes with our flagship audio drivers, a Discord-certified ClearCast mic, and extraordinary comfort.

    Learn more

  4. SteelSeries QcK Mousepads

    Designed for performance and durability, SteelSeries' best-selling mousepads come in a wide variety of styles and sizes, so everyone can find a mousepad perfectly suited to their needs.

    Learn more

Product Description

The apex 5 combines the high performance and click tactile feel of a mechanical keyboard with the extreme durability and convenience of ip32 water resistance. Built from the ground up for gaming, it also includes a premium magnetic wrist rest, OLED smart display, and per-key rgb. The apex 5 is the perfect hybrid between gaming and real life.

    How customer reviews and ratings work

    Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

    To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

    Customers say

    Customers praise the keyboard's build quality, noting it feels solid like keyboards from the 90s, and appreciate its ergonomic features with satisfying mechanical clicks.
